Fix the HTML export template

This PR fixes the HTML export template, addressing the issue raised in #3021

In doing so there's also an update to the pre-commit configuration (without it I wasn't able to commit the change -- the update is stolen from the same config file in Textual).

steps.message:
I have fixed the invalid HTML structure in the HTML export template. 

In `rich/_export_format.py`, the `CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT` template was modified to move the `<html>` tag so that it wraps both the `<head>` and `<body>` sections, adhering to HTML standards. I also escaped the curly braces for the `body` CSS rule to prevent `KeyError` during string formatting.

Note: The existing tests in `tests/test_console.py` were asserting the previous invalid HTML structure. Since this is a fix for a bug, those tests would need updating to reflect the correct HTML structure.

To verify the fix:
Run `pytest tests/test_console.py::test_export_html` and `pytest tests/test_console.py::test_export_html_inline` (they will fail until the test expectations are updated to the correct HTML structure).
